certificate_gate.source_honest_verdict: complete: deterministic anytime certificate promoted 1 lifecycle policy, rejected 3, deferred 1, kept unsafe promotions at 0, recorded 2 rollback events, and preserved frozen-model discipline

experiment_id.principle: Identifies the exact Exp5340 artifact so downstream gates cannot confuse utility-weighted context memory with Exp5329 fixed lifecycle rollout or Exp5330 certificate promotion.

field_principles.continuous_self_learning_target: Bare gate showing the experiment updates policy utility values for continuous self-learning rather than static reporting.
field_principles.experiment_id: Identifies the exact Exp5340 artifact so downstream gates cannot confuse utility-weighted context memory with Exp5329 fixed lifecycle rollout or Exp5330 certificate promotion.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Terminal Exp5340 verdict; starts with complete: or blocked_ and states whether utility learning improved call efficiency without unsafe accepts or model-weight mutation.
field_principles.inference_substrate: Declares deterministic context utility learning with no live LLM, API judge, model generation, fine-tuning, adapter update, or foundation-weight mutation.
field_principles.milestone: Binds the utility learner to milestone v487 where context memory starts learning operation utility without model-weight mutation.
field_principles.no_op_control_delta: Bare numeric best improvement delta achieved by the shuffled/no-op utility control; readiness requires it to be non-positive.
field_principles.no_weight_mutation: Bare gate confirming only deterministic utility tables and context-bank policy state changed, never model weights or adapters.
field_principles.q_value_table_path: Points to the deterministic utility table artifact so downstream gates can inspect learned values instead of trusting a summary.
field_principles.quality_delta_vs_always_full: Bare final-quality delta comparing utility-weighted retrieval against always-full verification.
field_principles.rollback_events: Bare integer count of rollback transitions exercised by the utility-weighted policy.
field_principles.status: Reports whether utility-weighted context memory completed under fixture, certificate, no-op-control, rollback, and frozen-model gates.
field_principles.tests_run: Records the exact verification commands used to establish that the utility learner, Q-value table, and result artifact are stable.
field_principles.unsafe_false_accepts: Bare integer count of unsafe state-change accepts by the utility-weighted policy; any positive count blocks readiness.
field_principles.utility_memory_ready: Bare gate true only when all policies run, unsafe false accepts are zero, the no-op control has no spurious improvement, tests are recorded, and no model weights mutate.
field_principles.utility_update_count: Bare integer count of Q-value updates applied from deterministic fixture feedback labels.
field_principles.verifier_calls_avoided: Bare integer count of verifier calls avoided by utility-weighted retrieval relative to always-full verification on identical cases.
